instruction: Complete the model in the opened Autodesk Revit environment using its automation interfaces, then export it to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc as IFC4. At the start of the task, use `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe` as the Revit entry point for this automation. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside Revit. The librarian wants a clearer arrival lobby, a reading room, book stacks, a small staff office, and a restroom, all within the existing quiet rectangular shell.
